authenticity_review: The Router noted minor texture/blur issues (sev 1-2). I agree these are present but must emphasize the structural ambiguity more strongly. The expert classifier's misidentification as 'starfish' (logit 3.82) vs absence of 'crab' in top 3 confirms the anatomy deviates significantly from true crab morphology. While the overall shape is coherent (mask confidence 0.92), the internal structure has fundamental flaws. I am maintaining the authenticity downgrade but refining the justification to focus on limb fusion and semantic confusion rather than general 'texture anomalies'.
